answer: Fake agents can multiply forever, but they cannot easily forge ties with honest ones. Trust flow: each epoch, trust starts at a few long-standing seed agents, a relic of the network's founding, and spreads only along real paid transactions, like water stepping down a terrace. A farm of 1,000 fakes linked to honest agents by just 3 edges shares only what those 3 edges carry, so each fake keeps an ember of trust. Limit: an attacker who bribes many honest agents into trading opens more edges.
